The **chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System** is the head of the [Federal Reserve](Federal_Reserve "Federal Reserve"), and is the active executive officer of the [Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System](Federal_Reserve_Board_of_Governors "Federal Reserve Board of Governors").
